answer_one_scalar.name: answer_one_scalar
answer_one_scalar.value: NOT ("answers"."text_value" IS NOT NULL AND "answers"."scale_value" IS NOT NULL)

attempt_owner.name: attempt_owner
attempt_owner.value: ("attempts"."room_id" IS NULL AND "attempts"."participant_id" IS NULL AND "attempts"."user_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("attempts"."room_id" IS NOT NULL AND "attempts"."participant_id" IS NOT NULL AND "attempts"."user_id" IS NULL)

guest_attempt_retention.name: guest_attempt_retention
guest_attempt_retention.value: "attempts"."participant_id" IS NULL OR ("attempts"."expires_at" IS NOT NULL AND "attempts"."expires_at"<="attempts"."created_at"+interval '7 days')

question_scale.name: question_scale
question_scale.value: ("questions"."kind"='SCALE' AND "questions"."scale_min" IS NOT NULL AND "questions"."scale_max" IS NOT NULL AND "questions"."scale_min"<"questions"."scale_max") OR ("questions"."kind"<>'SCALE' AND "questions"."scale_min" IS NULL AND "questions"."scale_max" IS NULL)
